# Brooke Ballhaus

> AI engineer and BS/MS student in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence concentration) at Stanford University. Builds systems that separate what should be automated from what is uniquely human. Work spans multi-agent reinforcement learning, mechanistic interpretability of LLMs, self-supervised computer vision, and full-stack AI products.

GitHub: https://github.com/bballhaus
Website: https://brookeballhaus.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/brooke-ballhaus
Each public repository below has an AGENTS.md with setup, run, and test instructions for coding agents.

## Research projects

- [emergent-cooperation-pandemic](https://github.com/bballhaus/emergent-cooperation-pandemic): Multi-agent RL (IPPO, MAPPO, DQN, peer incentives) on a multi-city SEIR pandemic simulator; an impact reward teaches selfish agents to share ventilators, cutting deaths 4-11% vs. selfish baselines. Stanford CS 224R, Spring 2026. With Riya Narain. Python, PyTorch.
- [cot-faithfulness-audit](https://github.com/bballhaus/cot-faithfulness-audit): Tests whether chain-of-thought in Llama-3-8B-Instruct is causal or post-hoc rationalization, using logit lens, tuned lens, and activation patching. Stanford CS 281. With Riya Narain. Python, TransformerLens.
- [showjumping-ssl](https://github.com/bballhaus/showjumping-ssl): Predicts showjumping jump outcomes from broadcast video with a self-supervised R(2+1)D encoder, a domain-adversarial venue head, and leave-one-venue-out evaluation to control for the venue confound. Stanford CS 131, Spring 2026. Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8.
- [mcphases-rl](https://github.com/riyanarain/mcphases-rl): Offline RL (fitted Q-iteration with behavior-cloning regularization, weighted importance sampling) for personalized menstrual-health recommendations from wearable data. Stanford CS 238, Fall 2025. With Nora Menon and Riya Narain. Python, scikit-learn.
- [HeuristicWithQLearning](https://github.com/bballhaus/HeuristicWithQLearning): Learns A* search heuristics with tabular Q-learning for imperfect mazes with loops. Stanford CS 221, Spring 2025. With Riya Narain. Python, Jupyter.

## Products

- [civitas](https://github.com/bballhaus/civitas): Helps small and medium government contractors find compatible RFPs aggregated from 62 California procurement sites, using source-aware semantic matching with per-RFP citations. Brooke led the 5-person team, ran 10+ user discovery interviews, and wrote most of 640+ commits. Next.js, Postgres with pgvector, AWS Lambda, Playwright, LLM enrichment.
- [rooted-prod](https://github.com/bballhaus/rooted-prod): Rooted, an AI decision partner and decision history for startup product managers: pulls team context, helps weigh options, and keeps a searchable record of decisions, rationale, and outcomes. Shaped by 16 interviews with product managers. In progress. Vite, React, Supabase, Vercel. Team Geckos, Stanford CS 177, Fall 2026. Landing page: https://rooted-stanford.vercel.app/
- [saipiens](https://github.com/elizamg/saipiens): SAIPIENS, a novel AI homework system that grades students' reasoning, not just their answers: teachers upload curriculum PDFs, the system extracts knowledge and skill objectives and generates units for students, grounded in research-backed pedagogy. Brooke is the top contributor (155 commits, 41 pull requests). Stanford CS 224G, Winter 2026. Live app: https://saipiens-chi.vercel.app/. React, Vite, Tailwind, AWS Lambda and Cognito, Gemini.
- Prose.ai: a website builder where plain-English specs compile into tested code. In progress, private repository.
- [BookClubB](https://github.com/bballhaus/BookClubB): iOS app for book clubs with groups, discussion threads, posts, and profiles. With irenealin. SwiftUI, Firebase.

## Team projects (private repositories, no public link)

- ReelLife: Narrative Unity game with day-by-day schedules, character stats, branching dialogue, and multiple endings. Built with Team Reithrodon for Stanford CS 247G, Spring 2026. Unity, C#.

## Open source

- [crewAI](https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI): Two merged pull requests to the multi-agent orchestration framework: an offline evaluation runner for agent routing and guardrail decisions (https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8230, 46 tests, mutation-tested) and credential-free AWS Bedrock contract tests (https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/9096). Also filed bug https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/issues/9095 (Bedrock Converse content parts).

## Skills

Python, PyTorch, TypeScript, Swift, SQL, AWS; reinforcement learning (single- and multi-agent, offline), LLM interpretability, self-supervised video representation learning, semantic search and retrieval.

AI-native development: Claude Code, Cursor, Factory; custom agent skills and MCP servers; every public repository has an AGENTS.md, one-step setup, and tests an agent can run.
